patients with schizophrenia are impaired in the ability to represent social intentions, but not non-social intentions.

patients with schizophrenia have a dysfunctional ToM system that is modulated by the intention represented.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the network supporting ToM in schizophrenia is dysfunctional and that the degree of dysfunction depends on the type of intentions represented.
ToM in schizophrenia is not a unitary phenomenon and that the dysfunction of the social brain is dependent on the type intention involved.
intentionality is a complex construct which cannot be captured by a single brain area or network.
